neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 2: type 1 interferonopathy (innate immune activation) (via MONDO:0700264 type 1 interferonopathy). leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 14: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3) (via MONDO:0033486 MONDO label 'leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 14'). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.21. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no pathway annotated for RNASEH2B, UFM1, so pathway overlap 0 is a data gap, not evidence of a different mechanism.
